s01.h1: Stop Double-Booked Units Across Every Sales Channel
s01.subheadingBodyCopy: Manzili connects your 3D showroom and web platform to your CRM and ERP, so unit status updates in under 500 ms and buyer activity flows straight to your sales team.

s02.h2: Sub-500 ms Two-Way Inventory Sync Across Every Device
s02.subheadingBodyCopy: Launches go wrong when one screen still shows a unit as available after it's been reserved. Manzili links your 3D models directly to your inventory system, so touch tables, LED walls and web sessions all show the same unit status.
s02.block01Title: Timed Unit Holds Across Every Screen
s02.block01Body: The moment an agent starts a reservation, Manzili places a timed unit hold and broadcasts it across every connected screen and session. Other tables and web sessions show the unit as Pending straight away, so two buyers can't reserve the same unit.
block01Features: Blocks a second reservation in under 500 ms
Records agent, timestamp and buyer ID
s02.block02Body: Pre-built connectors for Salesforce, Yardi Voyager, SAP RE-FX and HubSpot. Price changes, phase releases and payment-plan updates show in the 3D twin without engineering work or manual re-entry.
block02Features: Ready for Salesforce, Yardi Voyager, SAP RE-FX and HubSpot
Opens new blocks without manual re-entry
s02.block03Title: Buyer Intent Data in Your CRM
s02.block03Body: Every 3D interaction is recorded: dwell time by unit type, views checked, sun studies run and floor plans compared. It lands in the buyer's CRM record before they reach the negotiation table.
block03Features: Shows the most-viewed layouts and views
Gives agents each buyer's exact preferences
Ranks leads by depth of interaction

s03.h2: How Inventory Sync Protects Launch Momentum
s03.card01Body: Timed unit holds stop your team selling the same unit twice, even on the busiest launch day.
s03.card02Body: CCOs and sales directors see reservations, revenue and remaining inventory across galleries and digital channels on one console.
s03.card03Body: Buyers go straight from choosing a unit in 3D to the CRM reservation form while their intent is high.

s04.h2: Pre-Built Connectors for Saudi Master Developers
s04.subheadingBodyCopy: Every connector links your project inventory to the Manzili platform for sales and leasing. Connectors are pre-tested and hosted in-Kingdom under the Saudi PDPL.
row1: Unit inventory and reservations, plus leads and buyer activity
row2: Unit inventory, pricing and holds for sales and leasing
row3: Unit inventory, pricing and contract status
row4: Unit availability, plus leads and buyer intent events

s05.q1: What happens if two agents try to reserve the same unit?
s05.a1: The first timed unit hold locks the unit everywhere in under 500 ms. The second agent sees it as Pending and can pick another unit.
s05.q2: What happens to inventory sync if showroom internet drops?
s05.a2: The showroom app keeps running locally and shows the last confirmed inventory. New timed unit holds wait until the local network reconnects, so no unit is allocated without confirmation.
s05.q3: How does buyer intent data reach our CRM?
s05.a3: Interaction events, such as views checked, floor plans toggled and sun studies run, are sent by webhook to each buyer's CRM timeline, so your team sees their intent before the first call.
